name: Hanwha General Insurance Co., Ltd.
summary: Hanwha General Insurance Co., Ltd. provides insurance services in South Korea. The company offers long-term insurance, including injury, diseases, property damage, liability, and annuity; automobile insurance products comprising casualty and property; and fire insurance products. Hanwha General Insurance Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Hanwha General Insurance Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Hanwha Life Insurance Co., Ltd.
